messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 40(2)

Article 40 Information obligation of notified bodies. 2. A notified body shall provide the other bodies notified under this Regulation carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same kinds of machinery or related products with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results.

response.text:
A notified body | shallProvideInformation | relevant information on issues relating to negative conformity assessment results, to other notified bodies | the other bodies are notified under this Regulation and carry out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same kinds of machinery or related products | "A notified body shall provide the other bodies notified under this Regulation carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same kinds of machinery or related products with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results."
A notified body | shallProvideInformation | relevant information on issues relating to positive conformity assessment results, to other notified bodies | the information is requested, and the other bodies meet the same conditions as for negative results | "A notified body shall provide the other bodies notified under this Regulation carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same kinds of machinery or related products with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results."
